The exact stale-report gate passes locally after forced regeneration.

Its contents exactly match the frozen CI-generated report; forced regeneration followed by the workflow committed-report check leaves no diff.

<!--

Annotation-only replacement for #20775, independent of its messaging changes. Completes the 3.0 source-contract cleanup: `@WithSpan` and `@AddingSpanAttributes` target methods only; method instrumentation is unchanged.

Remove either annotation from constructors:

```java
// Before
@WithSpan
Example() {}

// After
Example() {}

// Method annotations remain supported
@WithSpan
void work() {}
```

- **API:** Restrict both targets to `ElementType.METHOD` and update Javadoc.
- **Tests:** Replace constructor fixtures and tests with method-only target assertions; preserve method-instrumentation coverage.
- **Migration:** Add the annotation breaking-change entry under stable breaking changes.
metadata.title: Restrict span annotations to methods
